comparison: Perfect agreement on dataset claims (C1, C2). Both evaluations find the datasets well-described and appropriate, with no concerns raised about selection or composition.
Perfect agreement on MOFA factor identification (C3-C7). Both evaluations support the methodology and findings, describing the evidence as solid with no methodological concerns.

Perfect agreement on Factor 1 characterization in BMMNC cohort (C8-C13). Both evaluations accept these findings as supported, though OpenEval notes the SINE:Alu interpretation (C10) is somewhat speculative.

Perfect agreement on CD34+ cohort Factor associations (C14-C20). Both evaluations support the findings, though OpenEval notes potential T/NK cell contamination concerns that are acknowledged but not fully resolved.
Perfect agreement on survival analysis results (C21-C25). Both evaluations accept the statistical findings and prognostic associations without concerns about methodology or interpretation.
Perfect agreement on RTE expression as risk factor (C26-C29). Both evaluations explicitly acknowledge this as a key finding with solid evidence, accepting the prognostic interpretation.

Divergent evaluations on inflammation as protective (C30-C31). OpenEval rates as UNCERTAIN due to speculative causal interpretation not directly tested, while peer reviewers accept the finding as SUPPORTED with interesting correlations.
Strong agreement on Factor 4 characterization (C32-C37, C90). Both evaluations support the immune and cellular composition findings, with peer reviewers finding substantial value for clinicians.

Perfect agreement on inflammation-survival associations (C38-C41). Both evaluations accept these correlations as supported, including non-significant trends, with evidence described as solid and interesting.

Strong agreement on SF3B1-inflammation associations (C42-C50). Both evaluations explicitly acknowledge this key finding with solid evidence. OpenEval also includes C51, C84-C85 which peer review addresses separately.

Divergent evaluations on SF3B1-inflammation-survival interpretation (C51, C91-C93). OpenEval rates as UNCERTAIN due to lack of statistical significance and speculative mechanism, while peer reviewers accept the trend as part of supported findings.

Perfect agreement on SRSF2 characterization (C52-C59, C87). Both evaluations support these findings with solid evidence, acknowledging consistency with known poor prognosis and immunological features.

Agreement on SRSF2 mechanistic interpretation (C94). Both evaluations support this interpretation, though OpenEval notes direct causation not established. Peer review groups this with broader background claims.

Agreement on literature context and supporting observations (C60-C67). Both evaluations accept these background claims, with OpenEval noting correlation doesn't establish causation for C67, while peer review addresses C67 separately.
Agreement on senescence-PD-L1 correlation (C67). Both evaluations support this observation, with OpenEval noting it supports the mechanistic framework without establishing causation.
Agreement on background information and study rationale (C68-C81). Both evaluations accept the contextual framework with appropriate citations, supporting the study's scientific foundation.

Agreement on methodological approach and negative finding (C82-C83). Both evaluations accept the inability to identify splicing factor mutation factor and the subsequent analytical strategy as appropriate.
Agreement on negative MOFA finding (C83). Both evaluations accept this limitation and the subsequent approach, with peer reviewers noting the efficacy of the integrative approach despite this.

Divergent evaluations on main conclusions (C86, C88-C89, C95-C96). OpenEval rates as UNCERTAIN, noting claims about superiority over scoring systems not directly demonstrated and clinical utility speculative. Peer reviewers rate as SUPPORTED, explicitly acknowledging efficacy of the integrative approach.
Agreement on statistical methodology for SF3B1 (C84-C85). Both evaluations accept the multiple linear regression approach controlling for confounding mutations as appropriate and rigorous.

Agreement on SF3B1 mechanistic interpretation background (C91-C93). Both evaluations accept the literature context, though OpenEval rates the overall interpretation as UNCERTAIN due to lack of statistical significance.
